description: An Obsidian-like Live Preview Markdown editor for VS Code with ordinary Markdown as the source of truth.
configuration.title: Markdown Live Editor
Development-only ATOK layer-isolation mode. `raw-cm6` is local CodeMirror only; `markdown` adds the Markdown language; `sync` adds project document sync; `preview` adds live preview and the custom Save/Undo/Redo keymap. Diagnostic modes never constitute a release configuration.
configuration.customCss.markdownDescript: Optional User Settings literal CSS applied after the built-in Live Editor style. `@import`, `url()`, external resources, and CSS larger than 64 KiB are rejected. A trusted owning workspace may additionally provide `.vscode/markdown-live-editor.css`.
configuration.wordWrap.markdownDescripti: Wrap body text. `follow` uses VS Code editor.wordWrap.
configuration.lineNumbers.markdownDescri: Show physical Markdown source line numbers.
configuration.minimapEnabled.markdownDes: Show the minimap. `follow` uses VS Code editor.minimap.enabled.
configuration.minimapSlider.markdownDesc: When to show the minimap viewport indicator.
configuration.linkHoverDelay.markdownDes: Delay before showing link previews, in milliseconds.
configuration.tableMinWidth.markdownDesc: Initial minimum table-column width in em. Columns grow with content.
configuration.tableMaxWidth.markdownDesc: Maximum table-column width in em. Wider content wraps or scrolls within the table.
configuration.tableBandSize.markdownDesc: Table add/delete control-band thickness in px. Structural gaps retain this size plus a safety buffer where needed.
configuration.compactSpacing.markdownDes: Use compact presentation for structural spacing such as headings.
configuration.structuralGap.markdownDesc: Structural presentation gap in px. Areas with table control bands retain a safe effective minimum.
configuration.imageKeepHeight.markdownDe: Keep the previous rendered image height while editing its Markdown source.

configuration.allowRemoteImages.markdown: Allow HTTPS images in a trusted workspace. Disabled by default. Reopen the editor after changing this setting; images contact their remote server. Enabling or disabling takes effect when the editor is reopened.
configuration.attachmentFolder.markdownD: Single attachment folder name beside the saved Markdown document. New images are copied here without overwriting existing files. Undo retains attachments.
